request.subject: PORTRAIT:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Change only the colours of the red parts: the red conning tower becomes deep crimson, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, with one gold-yellow cross on its side and a thin gold-yellow rim; the red pennant becomes crimson with a gold-yellow tip; the red tail fin becomes crimson with a gold-yellow edge. Keep the pale wooden hull, steel bands, portholes, shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
